newsitem.title: USA: Com Ed Byron, Ill. power plant at 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Com Ed Byron, Ill. power plant at 20 pct.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,120 megawatt (MW) Byron 1 nuclear power plant is operating at 20 percent and may have to shut down completely later today for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
The unit was scheduled to shut at midnight Friday for maintenance, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The early drop in power production was caused by a feedwater pump problem, the NRC said. The unit was operating at 97 percent of its rated capacity as of early Thursday.
The facility's neighboring unit, Byron 2, also rated at 1,120 MW, was operating at full capacity, the NRC said.
The Byron power station is in Byron, Ill.
Commonwealth Edison, as a matter of policy, does not comment on scheduled maintenance outages.
